acceptanceCriteria: Cause identified and fixed or worked around so base reports a known project location.
Live corvint e2e prove runs past this failure.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1535 (CCE, docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md). The chromium bundled with Playwright 1.64 reports project-location-unknown even at base, which blocks live CCE prove.
title: Playwright 1.64 chromium reports project-location-unknown even at base, blocking live CCE prove
